attributes.residual: CLOSED, real 0, EXACT. 163/163 instructions, 55 differing words: 54 pure register fields plus the single form word at +0xec, reproducing the prior record's measurement exactly (it reported 54 renaming + 1 STRUCTURAL). This function turned out to be the SIMPLEST member of the combined class, not a hard one, and the reason is worth recording: the destination register ALREADY agrees (r26 on both sides) and only the source differs (our r28 against the target's r27), so the re-encoded word `or r26,r28,r28` sets the same register from the same register as our original `addi r26,r28,0`. The value obligation is therefore VACUOUS - architectural identity, no dataflow of any kind - and `unconditional_recolor` carries no proof burden beyond the recolor the other 54 words already require. The prior record's framing that this site is barred because 'the form stage sees a recolor and the recolor stage sees a form word, and their ORDER cannot be fixed by reordering' is correct as stated and remains the right diagnosis; what it did not anticipate is that the fix is not a reordering of the stages at all but a change to WHAT THE FORM STAGE WRITES - our registers in the target's encoding, rather than the target's word.
